name: WaitForEventOnSAPCloudForCustomer
label: Wait for an Event on SAP Cloud for Customer and Resume
description: Pauses and resumes a workflow based on specific events occurring in SAP Cloud for Customer.

fields.name: ClientId
fields.label: Client ID
fields.description: The Client ID from SAP C4C App Management.

fields.name: ClientSecret
fields.label: Client Secret
fields.description: The Client Secret from SAP C4C App Management.

fields.name: Subdomain
fields.label: Subdomain
fields.description: Your SAP C4C subdomain (e.g., 'mycompany' in mycompany.crm.ondemand.com).

fields.name: ApiEndpoint
fields.label: API Endpoint
fields.description: The full endpoint path to poll (e.g., /salesorder/v1/salesorders('SO0000000001')

fields.name: PollingInterval
fields.label: Polling Interval (seconds)
fields.description: How often to check the status (in seconds).

fields.name: WaitCondition
fields.label: Wait Condition
fields.description: The condition to wait for (e.g., 'Status eq "Processed"').

fields.name: Timeout
fields.label: Timeout (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait before failing (0 = no timeout).

fields.name: ContinueOnError
fields.label: Continue on Error
fields.description: If true, workflow continues even if the request fails.

fields.name: Response
fields.label: Response
fields.description: Final response body when condition is met.

fields.name: StatusCode
fields.label: Status Code
fields.description: HTTP status code returned by the API when condition is met.
